nonmonotone_reservation.assumptions: Constant busy duration two; no retirement, reward paid immediately, future AC available only day3. This counterexample refutes unrestricted monotonicity, not the stationary offer theorem.

controlled_query_benchmark.scope: Artificial controlled observation-interface benchmark; not six-family empirical reward evidence.
